Figure 1. Structures of dolastatin 10 and selected natural and

Figure 2. Biosynthesis of Dol-10. (A) The gene organization of an
identified 45 877 bp fragment, including 10 predicted dol genes whose
predicted functions are indicated. (B) Scheme of the proposed Dol-10
biosynthetic pathway. Two O-methylations are indicated in red, while
the potential C-methylation is in blue.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Biochemical characterization of DolJ and BarH. (A)
Structures of compounds 1−3. (B) LC traces of DolJ and BarH
reactions with compounds 1 and 2 as substrates. The control reaction
was the same as the full reaction except for the presence of heat-
inactivated DolJ. (C) Compound 1 (green) was docked into the
active site of predicted DolJ structure (tv-blue), which was
superimposed with Chain B of the structure of PtmU3 (PDB ID:
6OMR) with its substrate [platencin (PTN) compound 11, cyan]26

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Identification of dol-like BGCs. The homologous dol BGCs
were identified in marine and freshwater cyanobacterial genomes. The
cluster alignment was performed by Clinker,29 and the biosynthetic
genes encoding enzymes with >50% sequence identity were
connected by the black-to-white shades according to the identities.
